name: Provo Security+
description: Provo: exam readiness for CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701). Acronyms, security controls, cryptography, threats, vulnerabilities and attacks, architecture, operations, identity and access, incident response, governance and risk, question qualifiers, mini-exams, and a one-page cram sheet. To add it, choose Tools > Provo Security+ > Add Provo Security+ note. It creates a note named Provo Security+ and opens it in the full-width tool.
author: Benjamin Smith
